chapter.v:
Why do
the nations rage,and the peoples plot a vain thing?

The kings
of the earth take a stand,and the rulers take counsel together,against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

“Let’s break
their bonds apart,and cast their cords from us.”

He who
sits in the heavens will laugh.The Lord will have them in derision.

Then he
will speak to them in his anger,and terrify them in his wrath:

“Yet I
have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

I will
tell of the decree:Yahweh said to me, “You are my son.Today I have become your father.

Ask of
me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance,the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

You shall
break them with a rod of iron.You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

Now therefore
be wise, you kings.Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

Serve Yahweh
with fear,and rejoice with trembling.

Give sincere
homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way,for his wrath will soon be kindled.Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
